q: Wasali nawa ne akwai a tsarin rubutun Hausa?
Wanne ne harafin boge a cikin waɗannan?
Kalmar 'Gida' tana nuna jinsi na...
Mene ne jam'in kalmar 'Littafi'?
Wane wakilin suna ne ake amfani da shi ga mutum na uku (namiji)?
Kalmar 'Sauri' a harshen Hausa tana nufin...
Wanne ne madaidacin rubutu na ranar haihuwa?
A cikin 'Yara suna wasa', wace kalma ce aikatau?
Wane harafi ne ke farawa da kalmar 'Ɗalibi'?
Kishiyar kalmar 'Fari' ita ce...
Menene ma'anar karin maganar nan: 'Kowa ya ci zuma da kyashi'?
opts: Duk abin da ka shuka shi zaka girba
Zaka samu wahala kafin ka samu daɗi

q: A tsarin lissafin Hausa, nawa ne 'Goma sha biyar'?
Wanne ne harafin wasali na gaba?
Mene ne siffa (adjective) a cikin wannan jimlata: 'Jar mace ta shigo'?
Yadda ake raba gaɓar kalmar 'Makaranta' shi ne...
Wace sana'a ce ake kira 'Kira'?
A al'adar Hausa, me ake kira ga taron da ake yi don raɗa wa jariri suna?
Wane kaya ne na gargajiya maza ke sanyawa a kasar Hausa?
Menene 'Sadaki' a wajen aure?
opts: Kuɗin da miji ke biya ga matar da zai aura

q: Sana'ar fawa tana nufin...
opts: Yanka dabbobi da sayar da nama

q: Wace rawa ce tafi shahara a ƙasar Hausa?
Wane ne sarkin kida a kasar Hausa?
Menene sunan abincin da aka fi sani da shi a kasar Hausa?
A al'ada, me ake ba baƙo idan ya zo gidan mutum?
Wace sana'a ce ake amfani da 'Kekuna da allura'?
Mene ne 'Kunge'?
Wane tsuntsu ne ake yawan bayar da tatsuniyarsa a kasar Hausa?
Wace sana'a ce tafi kowa yanci a kasar Hausa?
Me ake kira ga mahaifin miji a wajen matar aure?
Mene ne 'Dambe'?
Wane ne marubucin littafin 'Magana Jari Ce'?
Littafin 'Ruwan Bagaja' ya kunshi labarin...
Mene ne tatsuniya?
opts: Labarin kagagge don nishadi da tarbiyya

q: A cikin tatsuniyar Kura da Gizo, wanne ne ke nuna wayo?
Wakar 'Arewa Jamhuriyya' wakar wane ce?
Menene ma'anar 'Adabi'?
opts: Hali ko dabi'a da fasahar magana

q: Wane irin adabi ne Tatsuniya ta kasance?
A wane lokaci aka fi son bayar da tatsuniya?
Karin magana: 'Ba a raba hanta da ...'?
Mene ne 'Habaici'?
opts: Magana ta fakaici don cin mutunci

q: Wanne ne shahararren mawakin Hausa na birni?
Wanne ne jigo a cikin littafin 'Jiki Magayi'?
Menene 'Gadar Zare' a matsayin taken littafi?
Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan ba siffar Tatsuniya ba ne?
Mene ne 'Kirari'?
Wakar 'Bakandamiya' wakar wane ne?
Wanne ne rukunin adabin Hausa rubutacce?
Menene taken littafin da aka fi sani na soyayya a zamanin farko?
A cikin Tatsuniya, me ake cewa idan za a fara?
Me ake cewa idan an gama tatsuniya?
